# openobserve_groups (Data Source)

Lists the groups of an OpenObserve organization. Requires OpenObserve Enterprise.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openobserve_groups" "all" {}

output "group_names" {
  value = data.openobserve_groups.all.groups
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.

### Read-Only

- `groups` (List of String) Group names.
- `id` (String) Data source ID.
